label: Leche flan
note: Philippine caramel custard of condensed milk and egg yolks, usually steamed, rarely baked

about.text: The Philippine version of flan: a firm caramel-topped egg custard.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Caramel is set in the mould first (about 5 min), the custard poured on top, and the mould covered and steamed until just set. The egg proteins set gently in the steam, so the flan stays smooth; the caramel ends up on top when it is unmoulded. Quantities from one Filipino recipe site (6 servings).

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.name: caramelise
steps.note: 1 cup sugar melted to light brown on low heat in the mould.
Steamed with the mould covered in foil.
